fact_previews: PABAsoft is a platform-based solution designed to decrease the costs of special needs therapy and expand the reach of service providers.
The project was created by Marianne Hoffmann.
PABAsoft offers software built to respond more effectively to the growing epidemic of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).
PABAsoft improves the effectiveness of Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA), the leading therapeutic intervention model for children with autism.
PABAsoft captures video data and treats the child with customized programs.

fact_previews: PABAsoft improves the effectiveness of Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA), the leading therapeutic intervention model for children with autism.
Clinicians can monitor, discuss, and respond to each case without the delays of travel or the risks of relying upon interpreted paper-based data.
PABAsoft uses next generation web-based technologies such as Windows 8 and Azure (MS cloud), along with touch screen devices and video compression.
PABAsoft aims to inspire more children to recover from autism irrespective of where they live.
The reach of PABAsoft is worldwide.
